mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO aggregator_ent_date_profit (aggregator_id, date, ent_id, ent_profit, electric_quantity, count_price, average_price, count_profit) VALUES
( #{item.aggregatorId}, #{item.date}, #{item.entId}, #{item.entProfit}, #{item.electricQuantity}, #{item.countPrice}, #{item.averagePrice}, #{item.countProfit} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.date, a.ent_profit AS entProfit, b.totalProfit FROM aggregator_ent_date_profit a, (SELECT SUM(ent_profit) AS totalProfit FROM aggregator_ent_date_profit WHERE ent_id = #{entId}) b WHERE ent_id = #{entId} ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1
